summary: Irene Vance switched the Nightingale on Monday night, not Wednesday. Insolvent and owed two years of fees by Lucien Ravel, she spent the ten days of the restoration casting a replica from a silicone mould. On Monday she asked the night guard to pause the corridor camera 'for her photographs', put the fake in the display case at 23:09, and walked out of the loading door with the real bird in her equipment case. On Tuesday morning she shipped it to a dealer in Antwerp as 'restoration materials' declared at 900,000. The vault opening on Wednesday night that looked like the theft was Felix Dorn secretly replacing a faulty sensor; the owner with the debts and the raised insurance was at a card table across town.
motive: Insolvency, and two years of unpaid fees from the gallery — settled with a 900,000 private sale.
method: A replica cast during the restoration and swapped in when she returned the bird, with the corridor camera paused at her request.

timeline.what: Irene asks Odile Marchetti how insurers detect enamel replicas. Her studio is insolvent.
The Nightingale goes to Irene's studio for restoration. She casts a mould and makes the replica.
At Irene's request, Pavel pauses the vault corridor camera.
Irene opens the vault and puts the replica in the display case.
Irene leaves by the loading door with the real bird in her equipment case. Pavel holds the door.
Irene ships a crate of 'restoration materials' to Antwerp, declared at 900,000.
Felix Dorn sneaks in to replace a faulty sensor. He never opens the case. Pavel is asleep.
Lucien Ravel is at the Lantern Club, losing.
Odile Marchetti declares the bird in the vault a fake.

misleading.what: The Wednesday night vault opening and the hooded figure
misleading.why: Felix Dorn fixing his own faulty sensor in secret to save his contract.

misleading.what: Lucien Ravel's debts, raised insurance and false alibi
misleading.why: The insurer raised the cover; he lied about his whereabouts to hide his gambling.
Exactly what made the switch invisible: she was supposed to be in the vault on Monday.

unreliable.why: He slept through Wednesday night and back-filled his rounds — and he paused the camera on Monday at the culprit's request.

twist: The theft everyone was investigating happened on Wednesday night. The real one happened on Monday, in plain sight, by the person being paid to put the bird back.
